summary: Iterates directory entries from a global iterator list, builds a full path for each entry, dispatches to a filter check selected by argument a4 (or a mode byte at this+1), and appends accepted entries as 12-byte linked-list nodes to the caller-supplied struct whose head/tail live at this+4 / this+8. Returns the last iterated entry pointer.

local_names.this: result list container (head this+4, tail this+8, cached tail this+12, count this+16)
local_names.a3: base path prefix concatenated with each entry name
local_names.v6: accepted flag from the selected check function
local_names.v7: pointer to final path component after backslash trim
local_names.v8: raw result of first 12-byte allocation (result node)
local_names.v10: copied check output v12 stored at v9[2]
local_names.v12: output value (byref) filled by the check function
local_names.v13: 512-byte stack buffer holding the formatted path

operations.description: Initialize directory search: sub_565F80(lpFileName, 1, (int)a3, 1) sets up iteration over lpFileName with pattern prefix a3; return value ignored.
Pop the front node from the directory-iterator linked list at global 0x008AD3B0.
Iterate directory entries: while DirectoryEntryIterator(&unk_8AD3B0) returns a non-null result, process each entry; exit when it returns null.

Format the full path into the 512-byte stack buffer v13 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v13, "%s%s", a3, result), concatenating base path a3 with the current entry name; the format literal is the global string at 0x005BE860.
If a4 == 1, run the file validation check sub_45C400(v13, &v12); a non-zero v6 accepts the entry.
Else if a4 == 2, run DataFileCheckSizeQuery(v13, &v12); a non-zero v6 accepts the entry.
Fallback when a4 is neither 1 nor 2: UtilityFunction_8a60(*(unsigned byte)(this+1), &v12) selects behavior via the mode byte at this+1; a non-zero v6 accepts the entry.
If the selected check returned non-zero (v6), accept the entry: walk backward from the end of v13 while the byte at v7 is not 92 ('\\'), trimming to the final path component after the last backslash.

Allocate the 12-byte result node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success initialize *v8 = 0, v8[1] = -1, copy the trimmed filename through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v7), then store the check output v10 = v12 at v9[2]; on allocation failure v9 = 0.

If the result node v9 is non-null, allocate the 12-byte linked-list node v11 via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success set v11[0] = v9 (data), v11[1] = 0 (next), and byte v11[8] = 1 (flag); on allocation failure v11 = 0.
Append v11 to the caller struct's linked list: if head (this+4) is null, set this+4 = v11 and cached tail this+12 = v11; otherwise link the previous tail's next pointer *(*(this+8) + 4) = v11.
Set the tail pointer this+8 = v11 (new last node).
Increment the item count at this+16.
Peek the next iterator node with LinkedListNodePeek(&unk_8AD3B0); break out of the loop if the peek returns null.
Return the last DirectoryEntryIterator / LinkedListNodePeek result (null when the iterator list is exhausted, a node pointer otherwise).
